claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityHeader.range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item otherwise fits the existing magic_item activation family, save_gate payload, fixed DC, and resource_spent_linear damage scaling, but non-spell activated abilities currently have no authored range. Without a range field, the necklace's 60-foot throw cannot be represented honestly and the tracer would fall back to a false self-range context.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to detach a bead and throw it up to 60 feet away.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_necklace_of_fireballs.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
